<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 134.10955, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈133.1023 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈11 % M+1) indicates roughly ten carbon atoms. A formula that matches this exact mass is C₁₀H₁₃ (monoisotopic mass 133.1017 Da, within <1 mDa of the observed value). No oxygen or other hetero‑atoms are required.  

Thus the molecular formula is: C10H13.
